instruction:
Two-Storey Learning Annex Conversion Schedule

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png, C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt as a tab-delimited zone schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt with size at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, PLAY-HALL, STAFF, WC-CHILD, WC-STAFF, CLASSROOM-3, and CLASSROOM-4.
7. CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, PLAY-HALL, STAFF, WC-CHILD, and WC-STAFF are assigned to one storey, and CLASSROOM-3 and CLASSROOM-4 are assigned to the other storey.
8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [18.0, 8.0, 6.6].
9. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area.
10. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in this order: Z01 CLASSROOM-1 24.0, Z02 CLASSROOM-2 24.0, Z03 PLAY-HALL 48.0, Z04 STAFF 8.0, Z05 WC-CHILD 4.0, Z06 WC-STAFF 4.0, Z07 CLASSROOM-3 24.0, and Z08 CLASSROOM-4 24.0, each Area value with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
11. The sum of all schedule Area values is between 159.0 m2 and 161.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
